topic: Closing your oldest credit card vs keeping it open at zero balance (Sofia vs Demi)

scenes.narration: Closing an old card can drop your score eighty points. Today's patient checkup starts here.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon woman named doctor dollar, dark curly hair, round gold-rim glasses, kind smile, white doctor coat over teal scrubs, golden stethoscope shaped like a dollar sign, holding a clipboard with a credit-score chart, doctor dollar in a doctor's office holding a clipboard with a credit score chart falling sharply, comic burst banner reads EIGHTY FOUR POINT DROP, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Sofia and Demi are both thirty four with a fifteen year old card.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split panel of woman sofia and woman demi each holding identical credit cards stamped FIFTEEN YEARS OLD, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Both just paid the balance off to zero this month.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, both sofia and demi holding identical statements stamped BALANCE ZERO PAID OFF, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Sofia closes the card to remove the temptation completely.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, sofia holding scissors over a credit card, an account screen behind her stamped CLOSED, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Her fifteen year history vanishes and her total credit limit drops.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a clock behind sofia resetting to zero, a credit limit gauge dropping by TEN THOUSAND, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Demi keeps the card open and puts a five dollar Netflix charge on it.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, demi at a kitchen table with a phone showing a NETFLIX FIVE DOLLAR autopay on her old card, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: She sets the card to autopay in full every month.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, demi tapping AUTOPAY IN FULL toggle on her bank app, a check mark glowing green beside it, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Three weeks later Sofia's score drops eighty four points overnight.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, shocked sofia at a kitchen table looking at a phone showing a falling credit score chart, comic banner reads EIGHTY FOUR DOWN, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Her utilization jumped from twelve percent to forty four percent.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a utilization gauge swinging from green TWELVE to red FORTY FOUR, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Demi's score went up nine points over the same period.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, demi smiling at a phone showing a score chart up by NINE POINTS in green, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Same payoff, same month, but Demi kept her credit history alive.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split scene, left side sofia with a falling chart, right side demi with a rising chart, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Never close paid old cards. Keep them open. See you next visit. Stay financially healthy!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon woman named doctor dollar, dark curly hair, round gold-rim glasses, kind smile, white doctor coat over teal scrubs, golden stethoscope shaped like a dollar sign, holding a clipboard with a credit-score chart, doctor dollar holding a clipboard reading KEEP OLD CARDS OPEN, comic burst banner reads SEE YOU NEXT VISIT, kids comic book illustration
